overview: Surf House is the self-contained accommodation at The Unicorn on the Beach in Porthtowan, sleeping 12 across three bedrooms. It has an open-plan kitchen and dining space and a shared shower room, with the Unicorn's restaurant, beach bar and an on-site surf school alongside.
surfTripFit: Beachside location with a surf school on site suits group surf trips well.
